listening.definition: Giving your full attention to somebody who is talking.
listening.example: He listened to my whole story.

lts_voluntary_singleness.definition: Being single because that is the arrangement the person has chosen.
lts_voluntary_singleness.example: He calls it voluntary singleness, and he means it as a decision rather than a consolation.

ma_quotient.definition: The result of a division, without the part that is left over.
ma_quotient.example: The quotient of 87 and 7 is 12, with a remainder of 3.

maintenance.definition: The ongoing work of keeping software alive: fixing, adapting, and explaining it across years of changing conditions.
